info.title: NatureX
info.description: AI rating agency and sandbox exchange for living nature

post.description:
Create a password account in the live world and sign in.

A taken email returns a generic 409; without email verification that reveals the email
exists, a risk ADR-0005 accepts. No permission depends on the email.

409.description: This email can't be used to create an account

post.description: Sign in with email and password. Every failure is the same generic 401.
End this session now: the row is deleted and the cookie cleared. Always succeeds.

get.description: The signed-in account.

post.description:
Create a community in the caller's world. The caller becomes its owner, and its treasury
account (holds the retained stake, never signs in or trades) is created with it.

409.description: community_limit_reached or community_name_taken

Add a steward (owner only). Someone holding the community's asset shares can't join:
members can't trade their own asset, so they'd be trapped (409 `member_has_holdings`).

403.description: A reason code, e.g. owner_only or members_only

404.description: Not found in the caller's world

409.description: member_has_holdings, member_not_eligible or already_member

get.description:
The Steward home (T63; the community's members and same-world admins): its listings with
their status and next action, the community wallet (IPO proceeds and community-fund
payouts), the treasury's retained-stake dividends, holders (counted and ranked, never
named), recent quarterly payouts and the latest reports' stewardship recommendations.
Every number comes from stored rows (`app.services.community_summary`). Play money.

403.description: A reason code, e.g. owner_only or members_only

404.description: Not found in the caller's world

schema.title: Response My Communities Me Communities Get

get.description: Marketplace cards for the world's public assets: listed and suspended (T58).

post.description:
Create a **draft** listing in a community the caller owns or stewards, in the session's
world. Needs `attestation: true`; the polygon must pass T36's checks and not overlap a
submitted listing in the world or one of the community's own drafts. Nothing is public
until it's listed.

403.description: A reason code, e.g. members_only or admin_only

404.description: The community isn't in the caller's world

409.description: listing_limit_reached

422.description: Invalid body, or the polygon fails T36's checks: each problem is an item with `type` `polygon.<code>` (invalid_geojson, too_complex, self_intersection, too_small, too_large, overlap) at `loc` [body, geojson]

get.description:
The boundaries of the world's public sites (listed and suspended), simplified on the
server to at most 200 corners each, for the listing map's outlines and overlap hint (T33).
Only a hint: T36's overlap check on create and submit is what decides, and it also counts
listings under review, which stay private here.

404.description: Not found in the caller's world

patch.description:
Edit a draft (its community's owner or stewards). Only the fields sent change; a body
that changes nothing is 400 and writes nothing.

403.description: A reason code, e.g. members_only or admin_only

404.description: Not found in the caller's world

409.description: `cannot_edit_<status>`: only drafts can be edited

422.description: Invalid body, or the polygon fails T36's checks: each problem is an item with `type` `polygon.<code>` (invalid_geojson, too_complex, self_intersection, too_small, too_large, overlap) at `loc` [body, geojson]

get.description:
Every report of the asset, newest first. Versions leave out `ndvi_series` (the chart
is for the latest report: `GET /assets/{id}` or `GET /reports/{id}`).

schema.title: Response List Reports Assets  Asset Id  Reports Get

schema.title: Response List Prices Assets  Asset Id  Prices Get

The community's listings at every status, drafts included (its members and same-world
admins only): the Steward app's listing flow.

schema.title: Response List Community Assets Communities  Community Id  Assets Get

403.description: A reason code, e.g. members_only or admin_only

404.description: Not found in the caller's world

post.description:
Submit a draft for rating, or resubmit: a `needs_evidence` listing with new evidence or
newer satellite data, or a `rating` listing whose run failed (at most every 10 minutes).
In the live world, a new polygon's metrics are computed live on Earth Engine when that is on
(T60); such a submit counts against the live-rating quotas, while a polygon already computed
is free. Demo sandboxes never compute live.
The move to `rating`, its ledger entry and the queued run commit together; the run's
sealed report then sets `listed`, `needs_evidence` or `ineligible`. Follow it with
`GET /runs/{run_id}` or `listing_status` events.

403.description: A reason code, e.g. members_only or admin_only

404.description: Not found in the caller's world

409.description: `cannot_submit_<status>`, `overlap` (a listing submitted first claims the land), `evidence_required` (needs_evidence with no new evidence or newer data), `metrics_unavailable` (still no metrics for the polygon), `live_area_too_large` (too large to compute its satellite metrics live) or `run_in_progress` (Location: the active run)

429.description: `resubmit_cooldown`, `rating_rate_limited`, `rating_global_limit`, or, when the run must compute the polygon's satellite metrics live, `live_rating_quota` (per account per day) or `live_rating_global_limit`; see Retry-After

post.description:
Return a `needs_evidence` listing, or a `rating` one with no active run, to `draft`, so
the community can redraw and resubmit it.

403.description: A reason code, e.g. members_only or admin_only

404.description: Not found in the caller's world

409.description: `cannot_<event>_<status>` or `run_in_progress`

post.description:
Withdraw a listing that was never listed (draft, needs_evidence, or rating with no
active run). `withdrawn` is final; it frees the land and the community's open-listing
slot, and the listing stays visible to its community only.

403.description: A reason code, e.g. members_only or admin_only

404.description: Not found in the caller's world

409.description: `cannot_<event>_<status>` or `run_in_progress`

post.description: Suspend trading on a listed asset (admins, never on their own community's asset).

403.description: A reason code, e.g. members_only or admin_only

404.description: Not found in the caller's world

409.description: `cannot_suspend_<status>`: only listed assets

post.description: Resume trading on a suspended asset (admins, never on their own community's asset).

403.description: A reason code, e.g. members_only or admin_only

404.description: Not found in the caller's world

409.description: `cannot_resume_<status>`: only suspended assets

get.description:
The price the owner would launch at now: every term of `ipo_price =
fair_value_per_share`, computed by the market engine from the latest report, and whether
the launch would go ahead (`launchable`, else `blocked_reason`). Writes nothing; a later
report can change it, so the launch confirms it with `expected_price`.

404.description: Not found in the session's world, or not visible to the caller

409.description: `ipo_already_launched`, `asset_not_listed` (draft, under review, suspended…), `no_rating` (no usable report) or `ipo_price_too_low` (the price per share rounds to zero: issue fewer shares)

post.description:
Launch the IPO of a `listed` asset, once, at the previewed price (`expected_price`):
in one transaction the first `prices` row
(`reason: ipo`), the community treasury's retained holding, a `price_anchor` ledger entry
with every term and the primary float open for sale; a public `price_tick` follows. Play
money only: shares are sandbox units, not securities.

404.description: Not found in the session's world, or not visible to the caller

409.description: `ipo_already_launched`, `asset_not_listed` (draft, under review, suspended…), `no_rating` (no usable report) or `ipo_price_too_low` (the price per share rounds to zero: issue fewer shares), `ipo_price_too_high` (a share would cost more than a new account's starting cash: issue more shares), `run_in_progress` (a rating run is active) or `not_verified` (the live world needs a verified listing; a revoked verification blocks everywhere; T69), or `ipo_price_changed` (`expected_price` is stale)

post.description:
Upload one verification document for the listing (its community's owner or stewards).
The body is the file. It's checked by magic bytes, size, pixel and PDF limits in a worker
with a timeout; only then is it stored, privately. By uploading, the steward confirms they
may share it. Submit documents for review with `POST /assets/{id}/verification/runs`.

404.description: Not found in the caller's world, or not visible to the caller

409.description: `listing_closed` (ineligible or withdrawn), `document_limit_reached` (20 per listing), `storage_quota_exceeded` (the community's or world's document bytes) or `document_reused` (the same file backs another listing, unless that's a withdrawn or ineligible listing of the same community)

422.description: The file is refused: empty_file, unsupported_format, media_type_mismatch, image_too_large, image_malformed, trailing_data, embedded_signature, pdf_encrypted, pdf_malformed, pdf_too_many_pages, pdf_too_many_objects, pdf_active_content, inspection_timeout or inspection_failed

requestBody.description: The file itself (PDF, JPEG or PNG, at most 5 MB).

get.description: The listing's documents, submitted or not, oldest first.

schema.title: Response List Documents Assets  Asset Id  Documents Get

404.description: `not_found`: outside the caller's world, or the caller isn't a member of the listing's community or a same-world admin

get.description:
The original file, always as an attachment (`Content-Disposition: attachment`,
`X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`, `Cache-Control: no-store`). Loaded by
`(world_id, asset_id, id)`.

200.description: The original file, as a download

404.description: `not_found` (see the list route) or `document_not_found`

get.description:
The document's sanitised preview: a PNG re-encoded from the decoded pixels, at most
1600 px, with no metadata. Never the original bytes.

404.description: `not_found`, `document_not_found` or `no_preview`

post.description:
Submit 1–3 uploaded documents for review: a new current run with its deterministic
checklist (accepted format, not reused, boundary free, consent document attached) and the
fingerprint of what it vouches for. Any earlier run stops being current. **Adding to a
submission:** while the current run still waits for a decision, its documents are kept in
the new run (except `remove_document_ids`), so the reviewer sees everything; at most 3 in
all. After a decision, a submission starts afresh. Once committed,
the AI document check (T71) runs in the background where it's on; its untrusted suggestion
is for the reviewer only and never changes the checklist or the level.

404.description: `not_found`, or `document_not_found` (a document that isn't one of this listing's)

409.description: `listing_closed`, `document_already_submitted` (a new document was in a run before), `document_not_in_submission` (a removed document isn't in the waiting run) or `submission_full` (the waiting run's documents and the new ones are more than 3: remove some)

get.description:
Every run of the listing, newest first, with its checklist values, documents and the
reviewer's reasons (never the reviewer's identity).

schema.title: Response List Verification Runs Assets  Asset Id  Verification Runs Get

404.description: `not_found`: outside the caller's world, or the caller isn't a member of the listing's community or a same-world admin

get.description:
How this listing was verified (ADR-0006 §4): the level and its badge, the date, the
reviewer's role, each check's result, the ledger entry, and what was **not** checked.
Never documents, values or reasons.

404.description: Not found in the caller's world, or not visible

get.description:
Listings waiting for a reviewer in the caller's world, oldest first, with their current
run, one page at a time (`limit`, `offset`), or one listing's (`asset_id`). Listings of the
admin's own communities are left out (conflict of interest). Each item carries the run's
AI document check (`ai_suggestion_status`, `ai_suggestion`): an **untrusted heuristic** read
from the documents by AI models, to be shown labelled as such next to its excerpts.

parameters.name: asset_id

schema.description: Only this listing's item: an empty list when it isn't waiting (or is the admin's own community's); 404 when it isn't a listing in the caller's world.
schema.title: Asset Id

parameters.description: Only this listing's item: an empty list when it isn't waiting (or is the admin's own community's); 404 when it isn't a listing in the caller's world.

schema.title: Response Review Queue Admin Verifications Get

404.description: `not_found`: `asset_id` isn't a listing in the caller's world

get.description:
Listings in the caller's world whose current run was decided (verified, rejected or
revoked), the latest decision first, one page at a time (`limit`, `offset`), so a reviewer
can find a listing again after deciding it. Each item's run carries its decision; the
review page (`GET /assets/{id}/verification/runs`) has the full history. A listing with a
newer submission waiting is in the queue instead. Listings of the admin's own communities
are left out (conflict of interest).

parameters.name: level

schema.description: Only listings whose current run is at this level; all three if absent.
schema.title: Level

parameters.description: Only listings whose current run is at this level; all three if absent.

schema.title: Response Decided Verifications Admin Verifications Decided Get

post.description:
Approve the listing's current run: it becomes `verified`, a `verification` ledger entry
records the decision, and an asset suspended by a revocation trades again.

404.description: `not_found`, or `run_not_found` (not one of this listing's runs)

409.description: `run_superseded`, `run_already_decided`, `listing_closed`, `stale_run` (the listing changed since the run: it needs a new one), `checks_failed` or `overlap`

post.description: Reject the listing's current run with a reason the steward sees.

404.description: `not_found`, or `run_not_found` (not one of this listing's runs)

409.description: `run_superseded` or `run_already_decided`

post.description:
Revoke the listing's verified run, with a reason: in one transaction it becomes
`revoked` and a listed asset is suspended (`verification_revoked`), so orders are refused
until a new run is approved. Both changes are in the ledger.

404.description: `not_found`, or `run_not_found` (not one of this listing's runs)

409.description: `run_superseded` or `not_verified` (the run isn't verified)

post.description:
Upload one geotagged field photo for the listing (its community's owner or stewards).
The body is the file. Its EXIF position must be inside the listing (or within 100 m of its
edge) and its date at most a year old; only those checks' results are kept, never the
position. The photo is stored re-encoded, with no metadata, and read by an image model on
Nebius Token Factory when both checks pass and AI analysis is on (`analysis_status`: poll
the `Location`, `GET …/evidence/{photo_id}`).

404.description: Not found in the caller's world, or not visible to the caller

409.description: `listing_closed` (ineligible or withdrawn), `photo_limit_reached` (5 per listing) or `photo_duplicate` (this file is already uploaded)

422.description: The file is refused: empty_file, unsupported_format, media_type_mismatch, image_too_large, image_malformed, trailing_data, embedded_signature, inspection_timeout or inspection_failed

requestBody.description: The photo itself (JPEG or PNG, at most 10 MB), with its EXIF.

get.description:
The listing's field photos, oldest first, with each one's checks, and the confidence
the next rating would have with the validated ones (from the latest report).

404.description: `not_found`: outside the caller's world, or the caller isn't a member of the listing's community or a same-world admin

get.description:
Field evidence in aggregate, for anyone who can see the asset: how many photos, how many
validated, and the land cover and disturbance labels seen in validated ones.
One field photo's checks (the upload's `Location`; poll it while `pending`).

404.description: `not_found` (see the list route) or `photo_not_found`

delete.description:
Remove a field photo with its image and evidence event. A rating already sealed keeps its
own copy of what it cited; the next one won't count the photo.

404.description: `not_found` or `photo_not_found`

get.description:
The photo as stored: a JPEG re-encoded from the decoded pixels, at most 1280 px, with no
EXIF (so no location). Loaded by `(world_id, asset_id, id)`.

200.description: The photo re-encoded as a JPEG with no metadata

404.description: `not_found` (see the list route) or `photo_not_found`

get.description:
What changed from report `prev` to report `report_id` (two versions of one asset):
each changed number with its old and new value and delta, the grade change and the reasons
(stored Auditor citations, events, flags and data versions; no model is called).
400 `prev_not_older` when `prev` is a later version than `report_id`.

400.description: The reports belong to different assets, or `prev` is the later version (`prev_not_older`).

404.description: Either report is missing, in another world or not visible.

post.description:
Fill a market order for the signed-in user. `is_primary` is true if any shares came from
the IPO float. With `max_total` (buy) or `min_total` (sell), a fill worse than the quote the
user confirmed is refused with 409 `price_moved` and nothing changes.

404.description: Asset not in the session's world

409.description: `not_trading` (not listed, e.g. suspended, or its IPO hasn't launched; T59), `insufficient_cash`, `insufficient_shares`, `insufficient_supply`, or `price_moved` (the total is above `max_total` or below `min_total`)

get.description:
What an order would cost or pay now, slippage included (`engine.preview`), and with a
session the largest order the user can place. Read-only: nothing is reserved, and the
order fills at the price when it's placed. Errors match `POST /orders` for the asset and
the size; cash and holdings are checked when ordering (see `max_qty`).

Anyone may read a quote (`Action.BROWSE` on the asset). A signed-in user whom `TRADE` would
refuse (a member of the asset's community, an admin, a treasury) gets `max_qty = 0` and
the reason in `trade_blocked_reason`, so a quote never invites a refused order.

404.description: Asset not in the session's world

409.description: `not_trading`: not listed (e.g. suspended) or its IPO hasn't launched (T59)

get.description: The signed-in user's cash and holdings.

post.description: Stream a grounded answer: `sources`, then `delta` pieces, then `done` (or `error`).

429.description: `copilot_rate_limited`: the account's or the world's hourly Copilot questions, or the world's Copilot model calls, are used up

503.description: `copilot_unavailable`: the question can't be embedded (no key, provider down, LLM_BUDGET_USD reached) or only LLM_RESERVE_USD is left

get.description: My alerts in this world, newest first, a page at a time, with the unread count.

parameters.name: community_id

schema.description: Only alerts about this community's assets (members only)
schema.title: Community Id

parameters.description: Only alerts about this community's assets (members only)

post.description: Mark every unread alert of mine read (only those about `community_id`'s assets, if set).

parameters.name: community_id

schema.description: Only alerts about this community's assets (members only)
schema.title: Community Id

parameters.description: Only alerts about this community's assets (members only)

post.description: Mark one of my alerts read (idempotent). 404 if it wasn't delivered to me here.

get.description:
The world's Time Machine quarter, the next one and the event presets (T38). `available`
is false outside a sandbox (the live world): hide the controls, both actions answer 409
`time_machine_sandbox_only`.

post.description:
Advance the world to the next Time Machine quarter (or replay the current one): re-rate
every listed asset with that quarter's scenario, re-anchor prices, alert and pay the
quarter's revenue (T38). Runs inline, so the answer is what actually happened; progress also
streams as `rating_progress` events (trigger `time_machine`).

409.description: `quarter_mismatch` (not the world's next or current quarter; see `GET /admin/time-machine`), `timeline_end` (reset the demo to start again), `time_machine_sandbox_only` (not a sandbox: the live world) or `local_jobs_disabled` (`LOCAL_JOBS=false`)

post.description:
Inject an event preset into one asset of the caller's world: its deterministic effect on
the metrics, a re-rate (alert and price re-anchor as for any re-rate), then the stored event
and, for severity ≥ 4, its own alert (T38). The world's quarter doesn't move. Allowed with
`LOCAL_JOBS=false` (one asset, one run).

409.description: `asset_not_listed`, `no_current_metrics` (no stored rating to start from), `time_machine_sandbox_only` (not a sandbox: the live world), `run_in_progress` (Location: the active run) or `stale_metrics` (the asset was re-rated meanwhile; Location: the run; nothing was stored, try again)

503.description: `rating_busy`, `llm_budget_exhausted`, `rerate_failed` (Location: the run; nothing was stored) or `event_not_recorded` (Location: the run; the re-rate is sealed but its event isn't stored)

get.description:
The given alerts of the caller's world as their recipients got them, with how many
accounts each reached, newest first (T43: what a Time Machine quarter or event sent; its
response lists the `alert_ids`). IDs from another world, or unknown, are left out.

schema.title: Response Get Sent Alerts Admin Alerts Get

get.description: Recent call metadata for this world or asset; for per-run tool spans use /runs/{id}/trace.

schema.title: Response List Ledger Ledger  Asset Id  Get

post.description:
DEMO_MODE, admins and demo sandboxes only: edit a copy of one entry and show
verification failing. Writes nothing.

get.description:
The session's world: the live world when anonymous or signed in with a password, the
demo sandbox for a demo session. `me` is the signed-in account, or null.
`document_ai_check` says whether a verification upload may be read by an AI model here.

post.description:
"Reset my demo": restore the demo session's sandbox to the template, keeping its ID.

The live world is never reset: any other session gets 403 `demo_session_only`
(`Action.CONTROL_DEMO`).

get.description: Dynamic World land cover clipped to the polygon (transparent outside it).

404.description: Unknown demo site

get.description: Sentinel-2 true-colour thumbnail with the polygon outline.

404.description: Unknown demo site

get.description: Overlay bounds, palette and legend, thumbnail metadata, date windows and attributions.

404.description: Unknown demo site

429.description: `place_search_rate_limited`: this account's searches per minute; `place_search_busy`: the process's Nominatim slot is more than 2 s away (`Retry-After: 1`)

post.description: Start an async rating run for the asset; follow it with `GET /runs/{run_id}`.

403.description: `admin_only`: only an admin of this world, or a member of the asset's community, can start a rating run

404.description: Asset not found in this world

409.description: `run_in_progress` (Location: the active run), `asset_is_draft` or `asset_not_listed` (listings under review are rated through `/submit`; T58)

503.description: `rating_busy`: too many runs, or the run lock is busy

get.description:
The run's status and steps, rebuilt from its progress events (any worker can answer).
A run of a listing under review is its community's and same-world admins' only (T58).
A run's progress spans and model-attempt metadata; no prompts or raw model output.
Liveness probe for local Docker and hosted endpoints.
Readiness probe (DB checks land in later tasks).

AiComparisonOut.title: AiComparisonOut
AiComparisonOut.description:
One field of one document compared with the listing: both values, the excerpt, the verdict
and why. `compared_by`: `model` (Nemotron, holder name and place) or `code` (always the area,
and fields that couldn't or mustn't go to a model).

not_sent_reason.title: Not Sent Reason
not_sent_reason.description: `no_preview`: the document has no sanitised preview (a PDF without a scanned image on page 1). `not_sample`: a sandbox sends only sample documents.

area.description: The number and unit as read, e.g. `144 ha`.

area_ha.title: Area Ha
area_ha.description: The area in hectares, converted in code, when the area comparison used it.

instruction_like_text.title: Instruction Like Text
instruction_like_text.description: Text aimed at an AI model was found: a sign of manipulation.

AiDocumentReadingOut.title: AiDocumentReadingOut
AiDocumentReadingOut.description: What the model read from one document's sanitised preview (T71).

AiExtractedField.title: AiExtractedField
AiExtractedField.description:
A value a model read off a document, and the verbatim excerpt around it. Attacker-written
text: render it as plain text, never as HTML or Markdown.

notice.title: Notice
notice.default: Untrusted AI heuristic: read from the uploaded documents by AI models, which can be wrong or manipulated by the documents themselves. It never changes the checks or the verification level; a person decides.

AiSuggestionOut.title: AiSuggestionOut
AiSuggestionOut.description:
The AI document check of a run (T71, ADR-0006 §2), for the reviewer only. **Untrusted
heuristic**: show it labelled as such, next to its excerpts; it never changed a check or the
level. `status: failed` means no model answered (or the budget was spent): `suggestion` is
null. A run has no AI suggestion while the check is pending or when it doesn't run (the live
world while `VERIFICATION_AI_LIVE=false`): see the queue item's `ai_suggestion_status`.

unread_count.title: Unread Count
unread_count.description: Unread alerts matching the filter, on every page, not only this one

next_before.title: Next Before
next_before.description: Pass as `before` for the next (older) page; null on the last

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: grade_change / health_change: a re-rate moved the grade or the health score by ≥ 5 points; news: a News Scout event of severity ≥ 4

AlertOut.title: AlertOut
AlertOut.description: One alert delivered to the signed-in account (T75).

marked.title: Marked
marked.description: Alerts that were unread and are now read

status_reason.title: Status Reason
status_reason.description: Why the listing is in its status, as a code: listing gate failures (e.g. confidence_below_70), a suspension reason, no_satellite_metrics or rating_failed:<error> or rating_stale while rating (T58).

mock.title: Mock
mock.description: True when the latest report was rated from USE_MOCKS placeholder metrics (T58), not observed satellite data: show it as mock data.

price_change_pct.title: Price Change Pct
price_change_pct.description: Latest price vs the IPO price, in percent (2 dp).

trend.title: Trend
trend.description: Health vs the previous report: improving, declining or stable; null with a single report.

sparkline.title: Sparkline
sparkline.description: The latest prices (up to 30), oldest first, for the card's sparkline.

trading.title: Trading
trading.description: Orders are open: listed and its IPO launched (T59). False for a listing awaiting its IPO and for a suspended asset; orders on it are 409 not_trading.

geojson.title: Geojson
geojson.description: GeoJSON Polygon or MultiPolygon (or a Feature wrapping one) in WGS84; 10–50,000 ha, no self-intersection, no overlap with another listing in the world. Feature properties are dropped.

attestation.title: Attestation
attestation.description: Must be true: the community attests it may list this land (ADR-0005).

AssetCreate.title: AssetCreate
AssetCreate.description:
A draft listing in a community the caller owns or stewards (T58). The share terms are
set at the IPO (T59), not here.

status_reason.title: Status Reason
status_reason.description: Why the listing is in its status (see AssetCard).

total_shares.title: Total Shares
total_shares.description: Shares issued at the IPO; null before it (ratings until then quote a fair value per share at 1,000,000 reference shares; T59).

retained_pct.title: Retained Pct
retained_pct.description: % the community's treasury kept at the IPO; null before it.

mock.title: Mock
mock.description: True when the latest report was rated from USE_MOCKS placeholder metrics (T58), not observed satellite data: show it as mock data.

price_change_pct.title: Price Change Pct
price_change_pct.description: Latest price vs the IPO price, in percent (2 dp); as on cards.

ipo_at.title: Ipo At
ipo_at.description: When the IPO opened trading; null before the IPO (T59).

cached_example.description: Demo worlds only: a listing waiting in `rating` because its satellite metrics are missing or their live computation failed points to the nearest precomputed demo site, labelled as a cached example (T60). Always null in the live world.

latest_run_id.title: Latest Run Id
latest_run_id.description: A listing under review's latest rating run (follow it with `GET /runs/{id}`), for its community's members and same-world admins, who alone can load it (T33). Null for public (listed or suspended) assets and before any run.

rings.title: Rings
rings.description: The exterior ring of each part, [lon, lat], simplified to at most 200 corners in all; holes dropped. A hint for drawing and overlap, never a check.

AssetOutline.title: AssetOutline
AssetOutline.description: A public site's boundary, simplified for a map (T33).

truncated.title: Truncated
truncated.description: More public sites exist than were returned (oldest first are kept).

AssetRatingOut.title: AssetRatingOut
AssetRatingOut.description: An asset's latest report and price at one moment, as stored.

AssetSubmitted.title: AssetSubmitted
AssetSubmitted.description: A listing submitted for rating: follow the run with `GET /runs/{run_id}`.

AssetUpdate.title: AssetUpdate
AssetUpdate.description: Edit a draft (T58). Only the fields sent change; `null` clears country or description.

citations.title: Citations
citations.description: Metric or event IDs cited in the report

CachedExample.title: CachedExample
CachedExample.description:
Demo worlds only (T60): the nearest precomputed demo site, shown with its notice next to
a listing whose live satellite rating failed. Never the listing's own data.

CommunityMemberAdd.title: CommunityMemberAdd
CommunityMemberAdd.description: Add a steward by account ID (not email: emails are never a claim of identity).

CommunityOut.title: CommunityOut
CommunityOut.description: A community's public profile: no member or treasury identifiers.

CommunityRole.title: CommunityRole
CommunityRole.description: ADR-0005 §3: community roles come from membership, not from `users.role`.

role.description: The caller's role; null for an admin.

holder_count.title: Holder Count
holder_count.description: Distinct investors holding any of its listings.

payouts.title: Payouts
payouts.description: The latest quarterly payouts, newest first.

CommunitySummaryOut.title: CommunitySummaryOut
CommunitySummaryOut.description:
The Steward home (T63): members and same-world admins only. Play money; holders are
counted and ranked without names or account IDs.

CommunityUpdate.title: CommunityUpdate
CommunityUpdate.description: Only the fields sent change; `null` clears `country` or `description`.

projected.title: Projected
projected.description: The next rating's confidence with the evidence counted (same inputs otherwise); null before the first rating.

points.title: Points
points.description: Points validated evidence adds: 14.0 (0.2 × (1.0 − 0.3) × 100), or 0 when nothing is validated yet or the latest report already counts it.

counted.title: Counted
counted.description: The latest report already used validated evidence.

listing_min.title: Listing Min
listing_min.description: The confidence a rating needs to list (the listing gate's minimum); a `projected` below it would still leave the listing needing evidence.

CopilotDeltaEvent.title: CopilotDeltaEvent
CopilotDeltaEvent.description: A piece of the checked answer; the pieces concatenate to `done.answer`.

citations.title: Citations
citations.description: The sources cited in `answer`, in order of first use; every [ref] in the answer is one of them (others were removed before streaming).

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: model: Nemotron's checked draft; extractive: quoted from the sources by code (mocks, or the model failed or is over budget); refusal: not in the record.

asset_id.title: Asset Id
asset_id.description: Ask about one asset (it must be visible in the caller's world); omit to search every visible asset of the world.

ref.title: Ref
ref.description: Citation label used inline as [ref]: R{version} or E{8 hex}.

CopilotSource.title: CopilotSource
CopilotSource.description: A report or news event the Copilot read for this answer; `ref` is its citation label.

CopilotSourcesEvent.title: CopilotSourcesEvent
CopilotSourcesEvent.description: First event: what was retrieved (the caller's world and visible assets only).

last_decision_at.title: Last Decision At
last_decision_at.description: When the run was revoked, else when it was decided: the list's order.

DecidedListingItem.title: DecidedListingItem
DecidedListingItem.description: A listing whose current run was decided (#211): the run, with its decision and documents.

version.title: Version
version.description: The report version this reason was recorded with.

DiffReason.title: DiffReason
DiffReason.description:
Why something changed, from stored data only: the Auditor's cited text, a stored event
title, a flag's stored detail or a fixed template filled with stored codes (never new
model text).

DocumentType.title: DocumentType
DocumentType.description:
What the steward says a document is (ADR-0006 §2). `assembly_minutes` is the
consent-labelled document the checklist looks for.

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.description: Severity ≥ 4: the event itself alerts the holders and community (besides any alert the re-rate raises).

description.title: Description
description.description: The generic effect; curated sites use their own scripted encroachment and restoration.

EvidenceKind.title: EvidenceKind
EvidenceKind.description: Real uploads, or T76's generated fictional samples.

ai_analysis.title: Ai Analysis
ai_analysis.description: What reads the photos: model (MiniCPM-V on Nebius Token Factory, only with FIELD_EVIDENCE_AI_LIVE), mock (USE_MOCKS: a fake model, nothing sent) or off (no photo is sent to a model, so none is validated).

FieldEvidenceOut.title: FieldEvidenceOut
FieldEvidenceOut.description: A listing's field photos and their combined effect (the steward's view).

latest_taken_month.title: Latest Taken Month
latest_taken_month.description: `YYYY-MM` the latest validated photo was taken (never the day).

FieldEvidencePublicOut.title: FieldEvidencePublicOut
FieldEvidencePublicOut.description:
Aggregate field evidence for anyone who can see the asset: counts and labels only, never
a photo, a position or who took it.

instruction_text.title: Instruction Text
instruction_text.description: The image holds text aimed at an AI model.

FieldPhotoObservationOut.title: FieldPhotoObservationOut
FieldPhotoObservationOut.description: The perception model's labels for a photo (untrusted; they can only fail a photo).

gps_check.title: Gps Check
gps_check.description: EXIF position: inside the listing, near (within gps_buffer_m of its edge), outside, or missing. The position itself is never stored.

gps_distance_m.title: Gps Distance M
gps_distance_m.description: Metres outside the listing's edge for `near` (at most gps_buffer_m); 0 inside; null when outside (only that it's over gps_buffer_m is kept) or missing.

date_check.title: Date Check
date_check.description: EXIF date taken: ok (at most max_age_days old, not in the future), missing, future or too_old.

analysis_status.title: Analysis Status
analysis_status.description: pending (the image model is reading it), completed, failed (no model answer, the AI budget is spent, or the analysis was lost) or not_run (a geotag check failed, or AI analysis is off: then the photo can't be validated).

validated.title: Validated
validated.description: Validated field evidence: both geotag checks passed and the analysis found an outdoor landscape with no authenticity concern (rules in code).

reasons.title: Reasons
reasons.description: Why it isn't validated: gps_missing, gps_outside, taken_missing, taken_future, taken_too_old, not_analysed, not_a_landscape, no_land_cover, authenticity_concern, instruction_text.

event_id.title: Event Id
event_id.description: The evidence event of a validated photo.

FieldPhotoOut.title: FieldPhotoOut
FieldPhotoOut.description:
One field photo and its checks (the listing's community and same-world admins only).
The photo, re-encoded without any metadata, is at `GET …/evidence/{id}/image`.

direction.title: Direction
direction.description: `up` = a better grade; null if either grade is unknown.

shares_held.title: Shares Held
shares_held.description: Shares investors hold; the retained stake excluded.

unrealized_pnl_pct.title: Unrealized Pnl Pct
unrealized_pnl_pct.description: unrealized_pnl as a percentage of cost_basis (2 dp).

total_shares.title: Total Shares
total_shares.description: Shares issued at the IPO; the shares offered (the primary float) are total_shares × (1 − retained_pct/100), rounded down.

retained_pct.title: Retained Pct
retained_pct.description: Percent of the shares the community's treasury keeps (10–90).

expected_price.title: Expected Price
expected_price.description: The price per share the owner confirmed in the preview (`ipo_price`; trailing zeros don't matter): 409 ipo_price_changed if a newer report moved it.

IpoLaunch.title: IpoLaunch
IpoLaunch.description: The offering an owner launches (T59): shares issued and the % the community keeps.

formula.title: Formula
formula.default: fair_value_total = value_mid × 10 × health_factor × confidence_factor; ipo_price = fair_value_per_share = fair_value_total / total_shares; shares_offered = total_shares × (1 − retained_pct/100)

shares_offered.title: Shares Offered
shares_offered.description: The primary float, sold to investors first.

formula.title: Formula
formula.default: fair_value_total = value_mid × 10 × health_factor × confidence_factor; ipo_price = fair_value_per_share = fair_value_total / total_shares; shares_offered = total_shares × (1 − retained_pct/100)

shares_offered.title: Shares Offered
shares_offered.description: The primary float, sold to investors first.

launchable.title: Launchable
launchable.description: Whether POST /assets/{id}/ipo would go ahead now.

blocked_reason.title: Blocked Reason
blocked_reason.description: Why not, as the code the launch would return: ipo_price_too_high (a share costs more than a new account's starting cash: issue more shares), run_in_progress, or not_verified (the live world needs the listing's current verification run verified and still matching; a revoked one blocks everywhere; T69).

head.title: Head
head.description: Hash of the last entry; null when the chain is broken

broken_at.title: Broken At
broken_at.description: First failing entry; null when the chain is valid

submitted.title: Submitted
submitted.description: It's in a run (a submission). A waiting run's documents carry into the next submission (#210), so one document may be in several runs; each run lists its own.

has_preview.title: Has Preview
has_preview.description: A sanitised PNG preview exists: every image, and a PDF whose first page holds an image (a scan).

commitment.title: Commitment
commitment.description: sha256(private nonce ‖ file): what the public ledger holds for this document. It can't be matched against a copy of the file without the nonce.

ListingDocumentOut.title: ListingDocumentOut
ListingDocumentOut.description:
A verification document's metadata (the listing's community and same-world admins
only). The file is at `GET /assets/{asset_id}/documents/{id}` (a download), its sanitised
preview at `…/preview`.

next_action.description: continue_listing (draft), rating_in_progress, add_evidence (needs_evidence), launch_ipo (listed, not launched; owner), awaiting_ipo (the same for stewards and admins), view_on_exchange (trading or suspended), none (ineligible, withdrawn).

shares.description: None before the IPO: no shares exist yet.

recommendations.title: Recommendations
recommendations.description: The Auditor's stewardship recommendations from the latest report.

MeOut.title: MeOut
MeOut.description: The signed-in account. Never includes the password hash.

id.title: Id
id.description: Stable key; it matches the Auditor's citation ID where one exists (e.g. `metric:landcover.built`, `score:threat_pressure`).

old.title: Old
old.description: Value in the older report; null if absent there.

new.title: New
new.description: Value in the newer report; null if absent there.

delta.title: Delta
delta.description: `new - old`; null unless both are present.

reason_refs.title: Reason Refs
reason_refs.description: Indexes into `ReportDiff.reasons` that cite this metric.

MetricChange.title: MetricChange
MetricChange.description: One stored number that differs between two report versions (T37).

MyCommunityOut.title: MyCommunityOut
MyCommunityOut.description: A community the caller belongs to, with the caller's role in it.

NdviPoint.title: NdviPoint
NdviPoint.description: One month of cloud-masked Sentinel-2 NDVI (monthly median); also served on reports.

NextAction.title: NextAction
NextAction.description: What the Steward home offers to do next with a listing.

max_total.title: Max Total
max_total.description: Buys only: refuse with 409 `price_moved` if the order would cost more (the total of the quote the user saw).

min_total.title: Min Total
min_total.description: Sells only: refuse with 409 `price_moved` if the order would pay less.

total.title: Total
total.description: qty × fill_price in cents: what a buy paid or a sell got.

primary_qty.title: Primary Qty
primary_qty.description: Shares a buy took from the opening offer.

community_amount.title: Community Amount
community_amount.description: The part of `total` paid to the community (primary shares × fill price).

cash_balance.title: Cash Balance
cash_balance.description: The trader's cash right after this fill.

shares_held.title: Shares Held
shares_held.description: The trader's shares of this asset after this fill.

OverlayImage.title: OverlayImage
OverlayImage.description: Leaflet ``ImageOverlay`` input: the PNG spans ``bounds`` in Web Mercator.

retained_dividend.title: Retained Dividend
retained_dividend.description: The treasury's share of the dividends.

bbox.title: Bbox
bbox.description: South, west, north, east in degrees, when Nominatim has one.

PlaceOut.title: PlaceOut
PlaceOut.description: A place found by name (OpenStreetMap Nominatim), for flying the listing map there.

attribution.title: Attribution
attribution.description: Credit to show next to the results.

holdings_value.title: Holdings Value
holdings_value.description: Sum of the priced holdings' market_value.

cost_basis.title: Cost Basis
cost_basis.description: Sum of the priced holdings' cost_basis.

unrealized_pnl_pct.title: Unrealized Pnl Pct
unrealized_pnl_pct.description: unrealized_pnl as a percentage of cost_basis; null if 0.

starting_cash.title: Starting Cash
starting_cash.description: The play money every account starts with.

since_start.title: Since Start
since_start.description: total_value − starting_cash: realised and unrealised gains and dividends.

PublicCheckOut.title: PublicCheckOut
PublicCheckOut.description: A check's name and result only: the public panel never shows the values.

price.title: Price
price.description: Latest price per share, before slippage.

total.title: Total
total.description: qty × fill_price in cents: the cost or the proceeds.

slippage_pct.title: Slippage Pct
slippage_pct.description: Fill vs latest price, in percent (2 dp).

primary_qty.title: Primary Qty
primary_qty.description: Shares a buy takes from the opening offer.

community_amount.title: Community Amount
community_amount.description: The part of a buy's total paid to the community (primary shares).

max_qty.title: Max Qty
max_qty.description: The largest order on this side the signed-in user can place now (cash or holding, supply, size cap); 0 when `trade_blocked_reason` is set; null without a session.

max_order_qty.title: Max Order Qty
max_order_qty.description: The size cap for one order on this asset.

trade_blocked_reason.title: Trade Blocked Reason
trade_blocked_reason.description: Why the signed-in user can't trade this asset at all (an order would get this 403): a member of its community, an admin or a treasury. Null when they can, or without a session.

QuoteOut.title: QuoteOut
QuoteOut.description:
The price of an order now, before confirming it (play money). Nothing is reserved: the
order fills at the price when it's placed.

RatingRunOut.title: RatingRunOut
RatingRunOut.description: A rating run's status, rebuilt from its progress events (or its report's run record).

step.title: Step
step.description: queued, started, earth_obs, valuation, news, evidence, audit, fallback or done

changes.title: Changes
changes.description: Headline lines (health, grade, confidence, value_mid, fair_value_total).

grade_change.description: Null when the grade is unchanged.

metrics.title: Metrics
metrics.description: Changed numbers only; unchanged ones are omitted.

summary_source.description: Where summary_md came from: the stored, cited Auditor summary (auditor), a live Nemotron call (live) or the deterministic fallback (fallback).

data_version.title: Data Version
data_version.description: Earth observation data version, e.g. 2026Q3 or sim-1.

period.title: Period
period.description: Quarter the report stands for (a simulated version's quarter).

simulated.title: Simulated
simulated.description: True for Time Machine scenarios: scripted changes, never observed data.

rating.title: Rating
rating.description: Deterministic rating snapshot: metrics provenance, valuation, score and fair-value inputs (T19).

greenwashing_risk.title: Greenwashing Risk
greenwashing_risk.description: The Auditor's greenwashing risk; null when it was not assessed (no audit, or the Auditor fell back). Prefer this over auditor.greenwashing_risk.

run_id.title: Run Id
run_id.description: Rating run that produced this report (T27); null for seeds.

ndvi_series.title: Ndvi Series
ndvi_series.description: Monthly NDVI behind the report's trend, oldest first (the rating's metrics row). Served on a single report (GET /reports/{id}, AssetDetail.latest_report); empty in the version list and when the report has none.

ai_suggestion_status.title: Ai Suggestion Status
ai_suggestion_status.description: The run's AI document check: `pending` (queued or running, for up to 15 minutes after submission), `not_run` (off in this world, or no document may be sent to a model), `completed`, or `failed` (no model answer, a spent budget, an error, a lost job or a stored result that no longer reads).

ai_suggestion.description: The AI document check's result: an untrusted heuristic (see its `trust` and `notice`). Present when `ai_suggestion_status` is `completed`, and when `failed` with a stored result; null otherwise.

ReviewQueueItem.title: ReviewQueueItem
ReviewQueueItem.description: A listing waiting for a reviewer: its current, undecided run.

ReviewerRole.title: ReviewerRole
ReviewerRole.description: Who decided, as a role: the public ledger and panel never name a person (ADR-0006 §3).

totals.description: The sealed run's totals; null until the run seals a report

step.title: Step
step.description: queued, started, earth_obs, valuation, news, evidence, audit, fallback or done

RunTraceStep.title: RunTraceStep
RunTraceStep.description: A progress span with safe tool-result facts and metadata for every model attempt.

RunTraceTotals.title: RunTraceTotals
RunTraceTotals.description: Every model call of a run, as the runner summed them when it sealed the report.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: grade_change / health_change: a re-rate moved the grade or the health score by ≥ 5 points; news: a News Scout event of severity ≥ 4

recipients.title: Recipients
recipients.description: Accounts it was delivered to (holders and community members)

SentAlertOut.title: SentAlertOut
SentAlertOut.description: An alert as its recipients got it, for the admin who raised it (T43).

shares_sold.title: Shares Sold
shares_sold.description: Bought from the IPO float so far.

description.title: Description
description.description: The deterministic change applied to the metrics.

period.title: Period
period.description: The quarter to run: the world's next quarter (advances it) or its current one (replays it: only what failed is redone, nothing is paid twice).

replayed.title: Replayed
replayed.description: True when the world was already at this quarter.

stopped.title: Stopped
stopped.description: `llm_budget_exhausted`, `job_budget_exhausted` or a rate limit: later assets weren't re-rated; replay the quarter to finish them.

SimulateQuarterResponse.title: SimulateQuarterResponse
SimulateQuarterResponse.description: What a Time Machine quarter actually did, per listed asset.

detail.title: Detail
detail.description: Why it was skipped, failed or stopped (`no_time_machine_version`, `no_current_metrics`, `rating_rate_limited`, `llm_budget_exhausted`, a run error…).

SiteImages.title: SiteImages
SiteImages.description: Sidecar metadata for one demo site's overlay and thumbnail (``<site>.images.json``).

id.title: Id
id.description: Monotonic world_events cursor; null for transient heartbeats

seq.title: Seq
seq.description: Entry to edit; defaults to the latest

available.title: Available
available.description: False outside a sandbox (the live world): hide the Time Machine; both actions answer 409 `time_machine_sandbox_only`.

next.description: The quarter `POST /admin/simulate/quarter` advances to; null at the end of the timeline (reset the demo to start again).

TimeMachineOut.title: TimeMachineOut
TimeMachineOut.description: Where the caller's world stands on the Time Machine timeline (T38).

period.title: Period
period.description: The quarter it is shown as, e.g. `2026Q4`.

data_version.title: Data Version
data_version.description: `sim-N` for a simulated quarter; null for the observed baseline.

TimeMachineQuarter.title: TimeMachineQuarter
TimeMachineQuarter.description: One entry of the Time Machine timeline (`data/demo_sites/scenarios.json`).

pct_of_shares.title: Pct Of Shares
pct_of_shares.description: Of the listing's total shares, 2 dp.

TopHolderOut.title: TopHolderOut
TopHolderOut.description: An investor ranked by shares, without a name or account ID.

UserKind.title: UserKind
UserKind.description: ADR-0005 §3: only a `person` signs in with a password; treasuries never sign in or trade.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Optional note for the steward (at most 500 characters).

VerificationCheckOut.title: VerificationCheckOut
VerificationCheckOut.description: One deterministic check of a run, with the value found and where it came from.

VerificationLevel.title: VerificationLevel
VerificationLevel.description:
ADR-0006 §1. A run is created `documents_submitted`; `unverified` means no current run
(or one whose input fingerprint no longer matches the listing) and is never stored.

VerificationMode.title: VerificationMode
VerificationMode.description:
The deployment's verification mode when a run was created (ADR-0006 §6). T69 ships
`review` only; `demo` is T76.

level.description: The current run's level, or `unverified` when there is none or the listing changed since it.

badge.title: Badge
badge.description: `Documents reviewed by NatureX (hackathon process)` when verified, `Verification revoked`, else `Self-attested by the community`.

ledger_seq.title: Ledger Seq
ledger_seq.description: The `verification` ledger entry of the latest decision.

VerificationPublicOut.title: VerificationPublicOut
VerificationPublicOut.description:
"How this listing was verified" (ADR-0006 §4): public, for anyone who can see the asset.
Check names and results only; what was *not* checked is always listed.

VerificationReason.title: VerificationReason
VerificationReason.description: A rejection or revocation: the reason is required and shown to the steward.

effective_level.description: `unverified` once the listing's name, area, polygon or community changed since the run (its fingerprint no longer matches); else `level`.

VerificationRunOut.title: VerificationRunOut
VerificationRunOut.description:
A verification run, for the listing's community and same-world admins: the checklist
with values, the documents, and the reviewer's reasons (never the reviewer's identity).

remove_document_ids.title: Remove Document Ids
remove_document_ids.description: Documents of the waiting run to leave out of the new one.

VerificationSubmit.title: VerificationSubmit
VerificationSubmit.description:
Submit 1–3 of the listing's uploaded, not yet submitted documents for review. While the
current run still waits for a decision, its documents are kept in the new run too (at most 3
in all), except those listed in `remove_document_ids`.

retained_dividends.title: Retained Dividends
retained_dividends.description: Dividends paid to the treasury for its retained stake.

WalletOut.title: WalletOut
WalletOut.description:
Play money. `balance` is the community wallet (`community_wallet`) and equals
`ipo_proceeds + community_fund_payouts`; `retained_dividends` went to the treasury for its
retained stake. `total_received` is all three: the wallet plus those dividends.

document_ai_check.title: Document Ai Check
document_ai_check.description: What the AI document check (T71) does with a steward's own verification upload in this world, for the uploader notice (ADR-0006 §5): `uploads` (its sanitised preview may be sent to an AI model on Nebius Token Factory when submitted), `samples_only` (a sandbox: only NatureX sample documents are sent, never an upload) or `off` (the live world while `VERIFICATION_AI_LIVE=false`).

WorldOut.title: WorldOut
WorldOut.description: The session's world (ADR-0005 §2): `live`, or a demo sandbox (`visitor`).
